table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname=max(dbo.item.name), 
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	custcode=srbufferledger.custcode,
	srcatcode=max(srbufferledger.srcatcode),
   packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc),
   cust_alias = max(dbo.accounts.aliasname),
   accname = max(dbo.accounts.name),
   address = max(dbo.customer.address1),
   address2= max(dbo.customer.address2),
	customerphone=max(customer.phone),
	customerfax=max(customer.fax),
	customercity=max(customer.city),
   salesman = (SELECT SM.Name FROM Salesman SM WHERE SM.SalesmanCode = dbo.srbufferledger.SManCode),
   saleinvcode =max(dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode),
   headerno = max(dbo.srbufferledger.headerno),
	headerinvcode=max(dbo.srbufferledger.headerinvno),
	refno2=max(dbo.srbufferledger.custrefno2),
	refno3=max(dbo.srbufferledger.custrefno3),
	refno4=max(dbo.srbufferledger.custrefno4),
	customertaxno=max(dbo.customer.salestaxregno),
	date = max(dbo.srbufferledger.date),
   invdiscperc =max(dbo.srbufferledger.discperc),
	misccharges = max(dbo.srbufferledger.misccharges),
	flatdisc =max(dbo.srbufferledger.flatdisc),
	invsalestax =max(dbo.srbufferledger.salestax),
	gcode = max(srbufferdetail.gcode),
	icode = srbufferdetail.icode,
	batch = max(srbufferdetail.batch),
	expiry =max(srbufferdetail.expiry),
	looseqty =sum(srbufferdetail.looseqty),
	bonusqty = sum(srbufferdetail.bonusqty),
	packqty = sum(srbufferdetail.packqty),
	packunits= max(srbufferdetail.packunits),
	saleprice= max(srbufferdetail.srprice),
	discperc = max(srbufferdetail.discperc),
	salestax = max(srbufferdetail.salestax),
	Id = max(dbo.srbufferdetail.IDENTITYCOL),
	posted=max(srbufferledger.posted),
	unitsalestax =max(srbufferdetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc = max(srbufferdetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc =max(srbufferledger.invgstperc1),
	custTaxRegno=max(customer.salestaxregno)  ,
	custref=max(dbo.srbufferledger.custrefno),
	remarks=max(dbo.srbufferledger.remarks),
	TOTALLTR=SUM(Dbo.Item.PackingFactor * dbo.srbufferdetail.LooseQty),
	class=dbo.itemclass.name,
	size=dbo.itemsize.name
FROM 
	srbufferledger,
   srbufferdetail,
	accounts,
	customer,
	users,
	item,
	itemclass,
	itemsize
        
WHERE 
	( dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode = :ar_InvCode) AND  
	( dbo.srbufferledger.srbufferinvcode = dbo.srbufferdetail.srbufferinvcode) AND  
	( dbo.srbufferledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.srbufferledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.srbufferdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode) AND
	( dbo.item.iccode = dbo.itemclass.iccode) AND
	( dbo.item.isizecode = dbo.itemsize.isizecode)

GROUP BY
	srbufferdetail.icode,
	item.customicode,
	item.name,
	item.printable,
	dbo.srbufferledger.custcode,
	dbo.srbufferledger.Smancode,
	itemclass.name,
	itemsize.name
ORDER BY 
	Class, Size, ItemName

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.visible: 1	if( ROUND(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + SUM(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) For ALL), 2) >0,1,0)
objects.expression: ROUND(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + SUM(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) For ALL), 2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice)  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) )

objects.name: t_30
objects.visible: 1	if( ROUND(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + SUM(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) For ALL), 2) >0,1,0)
